title: Peak XV-Backed AI Startup Blacksmith Nets $66 Mn At A Unicorn Valuation
hook_text: Sixty six million dollars for Blacksmith.
script:
San Francisco code testing startup Blacksmith just hit a unicorn valuation.
The company raised sixty six million dollars in a Series C funding round.
Sequoia led the new investment into the AI testing platform.
Peak XV backed the firm in previous funding rounds.
Engineering teams use the software to automate bug checks as AI code surges.
Will your next software release be tested entirely by machines?
